exposure: Mackey Childbirth Satisfaction Rating Scale (Spanish adaptation)
Women's View of Birth Labor Satisfaction Questionnaire
pain (during labor, delivery, and just after birth)
outcome: psychometric properties of the Mackey Childbirth Satisfaction Rating Scale (factor structure, construct validity, criterion validity)
cohort: The study included 106 pregnant women (mean age = 31.86, SD = 4.12) recruited from a public university hospital in South Madrid.
finding: The adapted Mackey Childbirth Satisfaction Rating Scale demonstrated an adequate six-factor solution and strong construct and criterion validity, supporting its robust measurement of women's childbirth satisfaction.
cross-section timing: Data was collected around the childbirth period, including measures during labor, delivery, just after birth (for pain), and at an unspecified later point for post-traumatic stress symptoms.
